description:
## Overview

Search for hotel rates and availability across multiple hotels. This is your primary endpoint for finding bookable hotel rooms with real-time pricing.

## When to Use

- **Display hotel listings** with prices on your search results page
- **Show detailed rate options** for specific hotels users are viewing
- **Support multi-room bookings** for families or groups
- **Filter hotels** by location, amenities, ratings, or AI-powered semantic search

## What You Get

- **Real-time rates** with availability and pricing
- **Multiple room options** per hotel, sorted by price
- **Complete booking details** including cancellation policies, meal plans, and room types
- **Hotel information** (name, photos, address, ratings) when searching by filters

## Key Features

- **Multiple search methods**: Search by hotel IDs, city/country, coordinates, Place ID, IATA code, or natural language (AI search)
- **Flexible filtering**: Filter by star rating, facilities, hotel chains, accessibility, and more
- **Multi-room support**: Book multiple rooms with different guest configurations in one request
- **Performance optimized**: Default limit of 200 hotels (expandable to 5,000), recommended timeout of 6-12 seconds
- **Price consistency**: Optional `sessionId` holds the lowest-priced room-mapped offer of each hotel for the hotel page within a user session (accounts with price consistency enabled; see Multi-hotel and single-hotel consistency)

## Quick Start

**Required fields**: `checkin`, `checkout`, `currency`, `guestNationality`, `occupancies`, plus one location method (hotel IDs, city/country, coordinates, Place ID, or IATA code)

**Tip**: When searching by filters (like `aiSearch` or `cityName`), hotel data is automatically included. For direct hotel ID searches, set `includeHotelData=true` to include hotel names and photos.

**Price consistency**: Generate a unique `sessionId` per user search session and include it on every rates request in that session, using the same `checkin`, and `checkout`.

## Multi-hotel and single-hotel consistency

A multi-hotel search and a search for one of those hotels are independent searches. Unless an offer is held through price consistency, as described below, the same hotel can return different rates in each, even with identical parameters, so an offer from a multi-hotel response may not appear in a later single-hotel response. Common reasons:

- **Rates considered per hotel**: when a request covers 50 or more hotels (listed in `hotelIds` or resolved from a location search), a high `maxRatesPerHotel` is currently reduced (see that field). A single-hotel request keeps your value, so it can consider more rates.
- **Room mapping**: when room mapping is on, each mapped room keeps only its best offers by price, board type and refundability, and most offers that cannot be mapped to a room are removed. A different set of input rates can therefore produce a different result.
- **Response timing**: suppliers and other rate sources can respond differently, or at different times, from one call to the next.
- **Caching**: a repeated identical multi-hotel request, including the same `sessionId`, can be answered from a short-lived cache. Single-hotel responses are not stored in that cache.

**Keeping a listing price on the hotel page** requires price consistency to be enabled on your account. Send the same `sessionId`, `checkin` and `checkout` on the multi-hotel search and on the single-hotel request. The multi-hotel search then holds, for each hotel, its lowest-priced room-mapped offer, and the single-hotel request returns that offer, while it can still be served, and no cheaper one. If the lowest offer in the listing is not room-mapped, the held offer can be a higher-priced one. A later multi-hotel search in the same session replaces the held offer of each hotel it can hold again; other hotels keep theirs until the hold ends. A multi-hotel response served from the short-lived cache does not create or renew a hold.

The hold applies to single-room searches only. It lasts for a limited time set for your account, starts with the first search of the session and is not extended by later searches in that session; a live search made after the hold has ended starts a new one. When no offer is held for a hotel, the single-hotel request returns live rates, and its lowest-priced room-mapped offer, if it has one, becomes the held offer for that session. Availability can still change, so treat prebook as the final confirmation of price.

**Party, nationality and currency.** The hold covers one room only, and the held offer is also returned when the single-hotel request asks for other adults or children in the room, another `guestNationality` or another `currency` than the search that created the hold. Its price stays the held one, converted to the requested currency. Prebook then re-checks that room for the request's own party and nationality, and fails if it is no longer offered for them; search again in that case.

**Without `sessionId`.** On accounts with session-less price consistency enabled, a single-hotel request without `sessionId` returns the offer held for that hotel, `checkin` and `checkout` by the latest multi-hotel search of your account, whichever session it belonged to. That hold has its own expiry: the time set for your account, counted from the search that held that hotel's offer, not from the first search of its session. A hotel first held late in a session can therefore stay held after that session's hold has ended. The party, nationality and currency rules above apply. On other accounts, a request without `sessionId` returns live rates.

For listing prices that need to be held, use this endpoint with multiple hotel IDs rather than `/hotels/min-rates`, which is not covered by price consistency.

advancedAccessibilityOnly.description: If true, only hotels with advanced accessibility features will be returned.

aiSearch.description: AI-powered hotel search based on a natural language query. Uses semantic search to find hotels matching the query intent. You can scope results by passing cityName and/or countryCode (hard filters), or latitude + longitude + radius in meters (hard area filter). Location can also be included in the aiSearch string (e.g. '5 star hotels in Paris'). Cannot be combined with hotelIds, placeId, iataCode, or zip — the request returns 400. For exact brand matching without semantic search, drop aiSearch and use cityName + countryCode + hotelName. This is a valid main query.

amenityFilterLogic.description: Legacy logic applied to roomAmenities. 'AND': room must have all specified amenities. 'OR': room must have at least one specified amenity. Ignored when roomAmenitiesFilter is provided.

bedTypes.description: Filter results by bed types extracted from room names. Only rates from rooms matching the specified bed types will be returned. Example values: 'double', 'twin', 'king', 'queen', 'single'.

boardType.description: Filter results by board type(s). Can be a single value (e.g., 'BI') or comma-separated values (e.g., 'BI,HB') for OR logic. Example values: RO (Room Only), BI (Breakfast Included), HB (Half Board), FB (Full Board), AI (All Inclusive), DI (Dinner Included), LI (Lunch Included), BDI (Breakfast and Dinner Included), BLI (Breakfast and Lunch Included), LDI (Lunch and Dinner Included).

chainIds.description: An array of hotel chain IDs to filter the search results. This is a filter on top of the main query.

checkin.description: The check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (ISO 8601).

checkout.description: The check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (ISO 8601).

cityName.description: The name of the city to search for hotels in. Pairs with countryCode to do a country/city search. With aiSearch, cityName is forwarded as a hard filter on semantic search so brand or vibe queries stay in that city.

countryCode.description: The country code in ISO 2-letter format (e.g., 'SG' for Singapore). Instead of using hotel IDs, you can search by country/city. With aiSearch, countryCode is forwarded as a hard filter on semantic search (pairs with cityName). This is a valid main query.

currency.description: The currency in which the prices will be displayed.

facilities.description: An array of facility IDs. Results will include hotels with at least one of these facilities by default. This is a filter on top of the main query.

feed.description: Which feed to use when searching for rates. This applies only to accounts with multiple feeds enabled

guestNationality.description: The guest's nationality in ISO 2-letter country code format.

hotelIds.description: An array of hotel IDs to search for availability and pricing. These are usually pulled from MAQAMI LLC's `get_data_hotels` tool. Cannot be combined with aiSearch.

hotelName.description: A case-insensitive search for a hotel's name (e.g., 'Hilton').

hotelTypeIds.description: An array of hotel type IDs to filter the search results. This is a filter on top of the main query.

iataCode.description: The IATA code of the search location, typically an airport code. Instead of using hotel IDs, you can search by IATA code. Cannot be combined with aiSearch. This is a valid main query.

includeHotelData.description: If `true`, includes hotel data (name, main photo, address, rating) in the response even when searching by direct hotel IDs. By default, hotel data is only included when searching by filters (e.g., using `aiSearch`, `countryCode`, `cityName`, etc.). Setting this to `true` enables hotel data inclusion for all search types.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate for location-based hotel searches. Instead of using hotel IDs, you can search by lat/long and a radius around that spot. With aiSearch, latitude, longitude, and radius together constrain semantic search to that area (hard radius). This is a valid main query.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 200, max allowed is 5000.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate for location-based hotel searches. Pairs with latitude to do a lat/long search. Required with latitude and radius when using aiSearch for area-scoped semantic search.

loyaltyProgram.description: Loyalty program identifier used to request loyalty-eligible rates from supported suppliers. When set, rates that support the program may return member pricing and benefits.

loyaltyProgramDetails.description: Loyalty membership details forwarded to supported suppliers to unlock member rates and benefits. Provide one entry per loyalty program membership.

membershipId.description: The guest's membership ID for the loyalty program.

programId.description: The loyalty program identifier (e.g., 'HH' for Hilton Honors).

maxRatesPerHotel.description: The number of room rates (offers) to return per hotel, sorted by price (cheapest first). When a hotel has more rates than this, the cheapest are kept, by the price returned in this response. On an account with multiple feeds, a request for several `feeds` applies the number to each feed, so a hotel can return up to that many rates per feed. Set to 1 to just get the cheapest rate for each hotel, this is helpful for listing pages: with 1, more rates are fetched per hotel and the cheapest one left after room mapping and the other rate filters (such as `boardType` or `refundableRatesOnly`) is returned. A value above 1 also limits the rates fetched per hotel, before room mapping and those filters, so a small value above 1 can consider fewer rates than 1 does. Increase it if you are missing rate types. When a request covers 50 or more hotels, a value above 5 is currently reduced to 5, or to the number of occupancies if that is higher. On such requests, a value above 5 behaves like 5.

minRating.description: The minimum rating (on a scale of 0-5) required for hotels in search results. This is a filter on top of the main query.

minReviewsCount.description: The minimum number of reviews a hotel must have to be included in results. This is a filter on top of the main query.

occupancies.description: An array of objects specifying the number of guests per room. Required.

adults.description: Number of adults in each selected room

children.description: The ages of children of each selected room

offset.description: The number of results to skip for pagination. This paginates the passed hotels not the results returned so the actual returned results will vary.

placeId.description: The unique Place ID of the search location. Instead of using hotel IDs, pass a Place ID to get all the hotels in the specified region. Cannot be combined with aiSearch. This is a valid main query.

radius.description: The search radius in meters for location-based searches. Pairs with latitude and longitude. Required with coordinates when using aiSearch for area-scoped semantic search.

refundableRatesOnly.description: If true, only refundable rates (RFN) will be included in the response.

roomAmenities.description: Legacy room-level amenity filter. Only rates from rooms that match the specified amenities will be returned. Use amenityFilterLogic to control flat AND/OR behavior. If roomAmenitiesFilter is provided, it takes precedence over this field.

roomAmenitiesFilter.description: Grouped room-level amenity filter. Use '-' for OR within a group and ',' for AND across groups. Example: '1-2,3-4' means (1 OR 2) AND (3 OR 4). If provided, this field takes precedence over roomAmenities and amenityFilterLogic.

roomMapping.description: Enable room mapping to retrieve the mappedRoomId for each room. This allows you to link a rate to its specific room by combining it with hotel details, providing access to room images and additional information

sessionId.description: Optional client-generated session identifier for the user's search session. When your account has price consistency enabled, pass the same `sessionId` with the same `checkin` and `checkout` across related requests in that session; an offer is held only for a limited time: see Multi-hotel and single-hotel consistency in the endpoint description. On accounts enrolled in prebook at search, a single-hotel request that carries `sessionId` is prebooked while it is searched and returns only the offers the supplier confirmed, at the confirmed price. On an account with neither feature, `sessionId` does not hold or prebook any offer.

sort.description: Sorting criteria for the results. Multiple criteria can be provided, processed in order. The default sorting is by top picks (weighted by search popularity, review quality, and content completeness). Use 'revenue' to sort by historical booking value and monetary performance.

direction.description: Sort direction (e.g. ascending would sort prices by cheapest first when using 'price').

field.description: Criteria to sort by. 'top_picks' (default) ranks by search popularity, review quality, and content completeness. 'price' sorts by room rate. 'revenue' ranks by historical booking value and monetary performance.

starRating.description: An array of hotel star ratings to include. Ratings are rounded to the nearest half-star (e.g., [3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0]). This is a filter on top of the main query.

stream.description: If true, enables streaming mode where response data is sent incrementally instead of as a single payload.

strictFacilityFiltering.description: If enabled, only hotels with all specified facilities will be returned.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds before the request times out. This is when the live request for rates will cut off responses; it will take a few more ms to return the value.

zip.description: The zip code of the search location. This is a filter on top of the main query. Cannot be combined with aiSearch.
